name.baseName: Polyvinylchloride frame for a window of 1,23 m x 1,48 m

dataSetInformation.common:synonyms: Telaio per finestre in PVC, alla produzione
dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Dataset developed within the ARCADIA Project (production chain study regarding PVC frame for windows “PRODUZIONE DI TELAI IN PVC PER INFISSI E SERRAMENTI E PRODUZIONE DI FINESTRE IN PVC CON VETROCAMERA A DOPPIO O TRIPLO VETRO”). The dataset is representative of the Italian average processing technologies commonly used for the production of PVC frame for windows. The data set covers relevant process steps / technologies over the supply chain of the represented cradle to gate inventory with a good overall data quality. The inventory is based on primary data for PVC-U compounding and window assembly, and on secondary data (literature and/or LCI datasets) representative of Italian supply chain. The PVC frame for the production of windows is completed with reinforcement, hardware, gaskets, glazing blocks, screws. Dimensions: frame depth 76 mm; frame length 5.42 m; window’s dimension 1.23 m x 1.48 m.

referenceToExternalDocumentation.common:shortDescription: Giorgi S., Lavagna M., Campioli A., 2023 “PRODUZIONE DI TELAI IN PVC PER INFISSI E SERRAMENTI E PRODUZIONE DI FINESTRE IN PVC CON VETROCAMERA A DOPPIO O TRIPLO VETRO”. Internal report ARCADIA Project. Primary data of the main production processes (foreground data) collected from representative producers. Background datasets from Ecoinvent database cut-off (v.3.6) were used for the LCA study.

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Italy. Primary data collected at Italian compounding PVC-U plant and window PVC production plant. Dataset representative of Italian production of PVC-U frame for windows.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse: The production of PVC frame begins with the production of PVC resin (in Europe), from suspension polymerisation and emulsion polymerization processes. The PVC resin is mixed with additives in the compounding process, to obtain PVC-U compound, which is extruded, cooled and cut. The PVCs frame are covered with protection film. Finally, PVC frame and all components (reinforcement, hardware, gaskets, glazing blocks and screws) are assembled to produce windows. Use and end of life of the PVC frame are excluded. Scraps from extrusion process are recycled back into the system. 20% of recycled PVC is accounted for in the compound mix. Scraps from PVC-U compounding and assembly are recycled externally. Transport of the PVC resin to Italian manufacturing companies is included. Equipment and infrastructures, are not included in the foreground but are accounted for in the background datasets. Primary data (from Italian compounding PVC-U plant and window PVC production plant) and secondary data (literature and/or sector data) representative of Italian supply chain for the geographical characteristics and technologies used (machineries, equipment, etc) were collected. Inventory data have been collected as physical quantities of materials used in the different processes. The Dataset includes all window’s elements (reinforcement, hardware, gaskets, glazing blocks, screws), excluding the glass and spacer. The System Boundary of LCA is cradle-to-gate. The system boundary considers A1 “procurement of raw materials”, A2 “transport”, A3 “production”, in compliance with the EN15804:2012+A1:2013 standard. The production of machinery and infrastructure (and related maintenance waste), used for window and door production activities, is excluded from the system boundaries, except for those already contained in the Ecoinvent datasets used to model the background data. In accordance with EN 15804:2012+A1:2013, any electric motors and connected electric devices for opening/closing windows are excluded from the system boundary. The Cradle-to-gate analysis includes the input of raw materials, energy, water and the outputs of solid waste, air emissions, water emissions, and transport related to the considered system boundary. Background data were modelled according to Ecoinvent v. 3.6.
technology.technologicalApplicability: The PVC frame is for the production of windows, used as a transparent vertical closure of buildings.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.dataCutOffAndCompletenessPrinciples: Production of equipment and infrastructures is not included, except for the background system.
dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.deviationsFromCutOffAndCompletenessPrinc: None for the inventory. Completeness related to elementary flows cannot be evaluated.

review.common:reviewDetails: The review was performed in compliance with Arcadia Metodology “Metodologia per gli studi di filiera della Banca Dati italiana LCA” and ISO 14040-44 norms. The dataset has been assessed limited to the foreground data collected during the supply chain studies. Each dataset has been evaluated on the basis of the following 4 criteria: 1. Technological Representative; 2. Time Representativeness; 3. Geographic Representative; 4. Reliability. In this context reliability is very good. The data used are consistent, appropriate and reasonable in view of the goal and scope of the study. The system boundaries include all relevant processes and activity types from cradle to gate. A cut-off has been applied to production of equipment and infrastructure and to the processes involved in the recycling of PVC (only energy consumption for shredding has been accounted for). These are in line with the requirements of the “Metodologia per gli studi di filiera della Banca Dati italiana LCA” (Buttol et al., v2, November 2021). The LCI modelling choices follow the requirements of Buttol et al. (2021), such as allocation, consistency of included processes, and LCI methodology in general. It has been consistently applied along the whole dataset. The representativeness of the dataset (time-related, geographical, technology) is well documented and very good, thanks also to the involvement of relevant market operators. The precision and completeness of the dataset cannot be evaluated.
review.common:otherReviewDetails: The study was judged by the reviewer as compliant with both ISO 14040-44 and Arcadia methodology.
